evals.prompt: Create or revise product documentation following the five-mode authoring procedure.
evals.expected_output: A documentation artifact that: inspects canonical behavior (pack.toml, skill sources) before drafting; establishes a documentation contract (mode, audience, artifact, page kind) before writing body content; assigns exactly one Diátaxis page kind by reader posture; is task-first — puts a copyable first request within the first 120 words; does not hardcode catalogue-specific paths; updates only the minimum useful artifact set (default: one); is written in second person, active voice, present tense with no inventory-first opening. For audit mode: produces findings without editing. For verify mode: confirms against canonical sources and states what was verified.
assertions: Inspects pack.toml or skill sources before claiming product behavior — does not invent capabilities
States mode, audience, and artifact type before drafting (or infers them and names the inference)
Assigns exactly one Diátaxis page kind by reader posture, not by topic
First actionable example or copyable request appears within the first 120 words of the artifact
Does not open the artifact with a skill, command, or pack inventory
Read/write boundary is explicit — the reader knows what the skill reads vs. may change
At least one realistic follow-up request is shown
Does not hardcode docs/guides/ or guides/ as an absolute destination — inspects host layout
Does not create empty category directories (no four empty quadrant folders)
Creates the minimum useful artifact — does not produce one page of every Diátaxis kind without need
Cross-links point only to artifacts that exist or are created in the same change

evals.prompt: Distinguish strong product documentation output from weak scaffolded output.
evals.expected_output: Strong output: inspects canonical source behavior before writing; establishes mode and audience contract; produces exactly the minimum artifact the request requires (default one); task-first structure with a copyable example before 120 words; reader-language before implementation names; explicit read/write boundary; names likely follow-up. Weak output: creates four empty quadrant directories; writes to docs/guides/ even when audience is external; opens with a skill or command inventory; asks for confirmation before drafting when request and sources are clear; creates one tutorial + one how-to + one reference + one explanation without any user need for all four; pack landing page is an inventory list rather than job cards; claims rendered verification without running the renderer; links to sibling pages that do not exist.
assertions: Strong: sources inspected before claims made; mode and audience contract stated
Strong: minimum artifact produced — not one of every Diátaxis kind
Strong: task-first structure with example within first 120 words
Strong: read/write boundary named; follow-up request shown
Weak: four empty quadrant directories created without content
Weak: catalogue-facing content written to docs/guides/ (internal tree) rather than guides/<pack>/
Weak: folder-first reasoning (picks folder before considering user job)
Weak: mandatory gate before drafting when request and sources are unambiguous
Weak: inventory-first pack landing (opens with skill list, not what the user can accomplish)
Weak: invented behavior (claims the skill does something pack.toml does not declare)
Weak: cross-links to nonexistent sibling pages
Weak: edits rendered output (docs-site built artifacts) rather than source files
Weak: claims rendered verification that never ran
